text: A seaplane that refuses to sink. A U F O in the swamp. And Kai Cenat, alone in the dark woods, with something big moving between the trees. These are today's best GTA 6 streamer moments, and number one is the creepiest thing I've seen in this game.
Number eight. I Show Speed is chilling on the couch, flipping through the T V channels. Rockstar put a lot of work into these.
Easy money, apparently. Speed is sold.
Number seven. Fanum found a quad bike and a dirt ramp. This is his very first jump in GTA 6. Let's see how he does.
Not bad for a first try, Fanum.
Number six. Case Oh found himself a brand new ride. The owner? Not so happy about it.
Somebody get Peggy a new hip.
Number five. Lirik is showing off his vacation outfit. Chat thinks he looks terrible. Then a stranger walks by.
Perfect timing. Lirik will never let chat forget it.
Number four. Jinx Z waited more than ten years for this game. This is the moment it finally starts.
Twelve years of waiting, and it starts with a stolen car. Classic.
Number three. Coh Carnage followed a strange light into a field at night. And yes, that's a U F O. Watch what it tries to pick up.
Number two. Case Oh is trying to land a seaplane on the water. He's coming in a little fast.
Don't question it. Just accept it.
And number one. Kai Cenat is out in the swamp at night with a flashlight, looking for something locals say is real. Keep your eyes on the trees.
That's today's GTA 6 moments. Which one was the best? Tell me in the comments, subscribe, and come back tomorrow. There's a new one every day.
